sloka: अतीतानागतार्थज्ञो वर्तमानविचक्षणः ।मैथिलीमाहृतां दृष्ट्वा ध्यात्वा निश्वस्य चायतम् ।। ६.११४.७१ ।।
transliteration: atītānāgatārthajño vartamānavicakṣaṇaḥ ।maithilīmāhṛtāṁ dṛṣṭvā dhyātvā niśvasya cāyatam ।। 6.114.71 ।।

translations.english: "Indeed, I do not remember you being cowardly in war. The timidness that appeared in you is a sign of the adverseness of fate, for your destruction."
